principles: Each course belongs to exactly one of four pathways: strengths, stress-growth, fortification, or team.
Type association is a deliberate demo mapping device and is not a claim that a capability belongs exclusively to one Enneagram type.
Course progress is learner state and must not be stored on the canonical course object.
Hard prerequisites are used sparingly; most courses are standalone.
The Enneagram is demo content used to showcase interactive learning structures, not the product architecture itself.

strengths.label: Strengths
strengths.purpose: Develop capabilities associated with the learner's strongest types into more deliberate and advanced professional strengths.

stress-growth.label: Stress & Growth
stress-growth.purpose: Recognise pressure patterns, access growth resources and build broadly useful regulation and flexibility.

fortification.label: Fortification
fortification.purpose: Build useful capabilities associated with types outside the learner's strongest profile to increase behavioural range.

team.label: Team
team.purpose: Improve collaboration with different working styles and build shared team capability.

courseDataNotes.recommendationReason: Course contains generic recommendation context; persona-specific reasons should live in Recommendation records.
courseDataNotes.mapPlacement: Derived from pathway/category/level/chain plus learner/team context. Do not store arbitrary fixed coordinates in the course object.
